# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Whether the map picker and the ranking offer this location at all.
#
# The ticked continents narrow it; with nothing ticked the whole world is on
# offer, because a picker that shows nothing until a checkbox somewhere else is
# set looks broken rather than empty. Ownership is deliberately never asked --
# the whole use is planning for ground that is not yours yet.
#
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_in_zone = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_zone_count = 0
			global_var:bag_wtp_region_count = 0
		}
		region = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this } }
		AND = {
			continent = continent:europe
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:europe }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:asia
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:asia }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:africa
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:africa }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:america
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:america }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:oceania
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:oceania }
		}
	}
}

# **`trigger_if`, not `if`.** A trigger has its own conditional: `if` is an
# effect and `else_if` is nothing at all, which the game says once per line at
# load -- `Unknown trigger type: else_if` -- and the whole of this then came
# back true, so "only where it can be built today" filtered nothing whatever it
# was set to, for as long as the tick has existed.
#
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_can_build_something = {
	trigger_if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 } OR = { bag_wtp_can_build_29 = yes bag_wtp_can_build_30 = yes bag_wtp_can_build_18 = yes } }
	trigger_else_if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 } OR = { bag_wtp_can_build_29 = yes bag_wtp_can_build_30 = yes } }

# Scope: location
# an `allow` or a `country_potential` gates it besides the rank, so the tick does not override it.
bag_wtp_stands_ablaq_palace = {
	can_build_building = building_type:ablaq_palace
}
bag_wtp_stands_apothecary = {
	OR = {
		bag_wtp_rank_is_ticked = yes
		can_build_building = building_type:apothecary
	}
}
bag_wtp_stands_beer_workshop = {
	OR = {
		bag_wtp_rank_is_ticked = yes
		can_build_building = building_type:beer_workshop
	}
}
bag_wtp_stands_bog_iron_smelter = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			bag_wtp_rank_is_ticked = no
			can_build_building = building_type:bog_iron_smelter
		}
		AND = {
			bag_wtp_rank_is_ticked = yes
			# the building's own `location_potential`, copied from the game
			OR = { is_adjacent_to_lake = yes topography = wetlands } NOT = { raw_material = goods:iron }
		}
	}
}
bag_wtp_stands_brewery = {
	OR = {
		bag_wtp_rank_is_ticked = yes
		can_build_building = building_type:brewery
	}
}
bag_wtp_stands_brewery_manufactory = {

}
bag_wtp_stands_weapon_workshop = {
	OR = {
		bag_wtp_rank_is_ticked = yes
		can_build_building = building_type:weapon_workshop
	}
}

		can_build_building = building_type:winery
	}
}
